tasks.title: Announcement #21
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: Man: Good afternoon, everyone. I am excited to inform you that Dr. Cynthia Palmer, a renowned expert in environmental science, will be giving a guest lecture next Monday at 2 PM in Waldman Auditorium. Dr. Palmer will discuss the latest advancements in sustainable energy solutions and their impact on global climate change. Due to her popularity and the high interest in her work, I highly recommend arriving early to secure a seat.

options.B: A different location for a class

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这则通知是关于什么的，属于主旨/话题识别题，需抓住男士整段话的核心内容。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 男士明确告知Dr. Cynthia Palmer将做一场客座讲座（guest lecture），并说明了时间、地点和讲座主题，整段话的核心内容是通知一场客座讲座。 选项B：错误。 通知中提到讲座地点在Waldman Auditorium，但并未说明课程地点有变更，属于无关信息。 选项C：错误。 通知中没有提到任何课程要求，属于无中生有。 选项D：错误。 通知中介绍的是一场客座讲座，而非一门新的大学科学课程，属于概念混淆。

questions.stem: Why does the professor mention Dr. Palmer’s popularity?

options.A: To encourage students to read her work
options.B: To indicate why she was invited to the university
options.C: To compare her to other invited experts
options.D: To explain why students should arrive early

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问教授为什么提到Dr. Palmer很受欢迎，属于推理判断题，需抓住男士提到“popularity”时的上下文逻辑。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 男士提到Dr. Palmer很受欢迎，但并未鼓励学生去阅读她的著作，属于无中生有。 选项B：错误。 通知中没有说明Dr. Palmer被邀请的原因，只是介绍了她将来做讲座，属于无关信息。 选项C：错误。 通知中没有将Dr. Palmer与其他受邀专家进行比较，属于无中生有。 选项D：正确。 男士明确说“Due to her popularity and the high interest in her work, I highly recommend arriving early to secure a seat.”，即因为Dr. Palmer很受欢迎、大家兴趣很高，所以建议早点到场占座。
